title: Fayol's 14 Principles Explained Simply | Principles of Management Ep 9
description:
Chai Corner now has six people, but nobody knows who the boss is. Asha gets opposite orders, two people wash the same cups, and nobody counts the money. In this animated lesson we use Ravi's chai stall to understand Henri Fayol's administrative management in the simplest way possible.

You will meet Henri Fayol, the French mining engineer who wrote Administration Industrielle et Generale in 1916 and is often called the father of modern management. You will learn his 5 functions of management (planning, organizing, commanding, coordinating and controlling), see all 14 principles of management, and understand four key ones with Chai Corner examples: division of work, unity of command, scalar chain (with the gang plank) and esprit de corps.

This is Episode 9 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.

In this video:
0:00 Six people, no clear boss
0:22 Who was Henri Fayol?
0:40 What is administrative management?
0:53 Fayol's 5 functions of management
1:17 The 14 principles of management
1:27 Four key principles, explained
2:10 Quick check
2:24 Recap
